s0402.idiomatic: Ninth month, on bingchen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0403.literal: Achazhi dejin presented a large cotton-yarn tent.
s0403.idiomatic: Achazhi dejin presented a large cotton-yarn tent.

s0404.idiomatic: An edict said: "The Directorate of Education shall still follow the former system of annually selecting 6 students who have completed their studies for presentation.

s0405.literal: " Buying civilian land by monks and Daoists was forbidden; violators were punished and the purchase price confiscated.
s0405.idiomatic: " Buying civilian land by monks and Daoists was forbidden; violators were punished and the purchase price confiscated.

s0406.idiomatic: On renyin day Ningxia Route experienced an earthquake.

s0407.literal: On renzi day Venus transgressed Fang.
s0407.idiomatic: On renzi day Venus transgressed Fang.

s0408.idiomatic: On jiayin day Song Wangbao, native official of Huguang, came to present local products.

s0409.idiomatic: On renxu day Huanchi and others were dispatched as envoys to the departments of Prince Qiebie and others.

s0410.literal: On jiazi day the censors said: "Guanghai is an ancient place of exile; we request that corrupt officials be sent there as a warning.
s0410.idiomatic: On jiazi day the censors said: "Guanghai is an ancient place of exile; we request that corrupt officials be sent there as a warning.

s0412.literal: Baoding and Zhending two routes suffered famine; thirty thousand shi of grain and fifteen thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0412.idiomatic: Baoding and Zhending 2 routes suffered famine; 30,000 shi of grain and 15,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0413.idiomatic: Intercalary month, on dingmao day, princes Chechetut and Hundu Temür were each granted 5,000 ingots of notes.

s0414.literal: On jisi day Venus crossed the sky.
s0414.idiomatic: On jisi day Venus crossed the sky.

s0415.literal: The imperial carriage arrived at Dadu.
s0415.idiomatic: The imperial carriage arrived at Dadu.

s0416.literal: On renshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm on account of calamities and portents.
s0416.idiomatic: On renshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm on account of calamities and portents.

s0417.literal: Yao bandits of the Two Rivers of Guangxi raided; the local authorities were ordered to capture them.
s0417.idiomatic: Yao bandits of the Two Rivers of Guangxi raided; the local authorities were ordered to capture them.

s0418.literal: On jiaxu day orders were issued to sacrifice to Heaven and Earth, offer at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and perform rites at the Five Sacred Mountains, Four Great Rivers, and famous mountains and great streams.
s0418.idiomatic: On jiaxu day orders were issued to sacrifice to Heaven and Earth, offer at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and perform rites at the Five Sacred Mountains, Four Great Rivers, and famous mountains and great streams.

s0419.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Babai Sangu barbarians requested official guardianship; the Mengqing Pacification Commissioner's Headquarters of Chief Commander and Mu'an and Mengjie 2 prefectures were established in their territory; associate commissioner of the Wusa Pacification Commission NICHU Gong and native official Zhao Natong were both made pacification commissioners and chief commanders; Zhao's envoy Mi De was made associate pacification commissioner and vice commander; Natong's son Zhao Sanjin was made prefect of Mu'an, and his nephew Hunpen was made prefect of Mengjie; ingots of notes and silks were still granted in varying amounts.

s0420.literal: Jianchang, Ganzhou, Huizhou, and other routes suffered famine; forty-four thousand shi of grain were granted in relief.
s0420.idiomatic: Jianchang, Ganzhou, Huizhou, and other routes suffered famine; 44,000 shi of grain were granted in relief.

s0421.literal: Tufan Jie Prefecture suffered famine; fifteen hundred ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0421.idiomatic: Tufan Jie Prefecture suffered famine; 1,500 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0422.literal: Fengyuan, Qingyuan, Yan'an, and other routes suffered famine; grain was issued and sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.
s0422.idiomatic: Fengyuan, Qingyuan, Yan'an, and other routes suffered famine; grain was issued and sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.

s0423.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingshen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0423.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on bingshen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0424.literal: On wuxu day princes Tobie Temür, Ha'erman, and others presented jade and grape wine; six thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0424.idiomatic: On wuxu day princes Tobie Temür, Ha'erman, and others presented jade and grape wine; 6,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0425.literal: On jihai day censor Dezhu requested selection of Eastern Palace officials.
s0425.idiomatic: On jihai day censor Dezhu requested selection of Eastern Palace officials.

s0426.literal: On guimao day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Dayuanyan Sacred Temple of Great Celestial Origin.
s0426.idiomatic: On guimao day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Dayuanyan Sacred Temple of Great Celestial Origin.

s0427.literal: On jiachen day the deity of Wulong Mountain along Jiande Route was re-enfeoffed as King Zhongxian Lingze Puyou Fuhui.
s0427.idiomatic: On jiachen day the deity of Wulong Mountain along Jiande Route was re-enfeoffed as King Zhongxian Lingze Puyou Fuhui.

s0428.literal: On yisi day a meteor was seen in daytime.
s0428.idiomatic: On yisi day a meteor was seen in daytime.

s0429.literal: On jiyou day investigating censor Wang Shixi was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.
s0429.idiomatic: On jiyou day investigating censor Wang Shixi was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0430.idiomatic: On xinhai day investigating censor Yiqielie Taibuda said the Directorate of Waterways and Colonization disturbed the people and requested its abolition.

s0432.idiomatic: Ma Yu and other native officials of Shamuzhai, Yunnan, came to court.

s0433.idiomatic: On dingsi day investigating censor-in-chief Zhao Shiyan was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, and central secretariat participant Fu Yanqi was made Minister of Personnel.

s0434.idiomatic: Censor Han Yong said: "The rank of Minister is third grade; Yanqi rose through clerical posts to fourth grade — by law he may not be promoted.

s0436.literal: Annam sent envoys to present local products.
s0436.idiomatic: Annam sent envoys to present local products.

s0437.literal: On wuwu day Mercury transgressed Dongxian.
s0437.idiomatic: On wuwu day Mercury transgressed Dongxian.

s0438.idiomatic: Investigating censor Feng Sizhong requested that the Court of Imperial Sacrifices be ordered to compile the ritual regulations of successive reigns.

s0456.idiomatic: Camels and cattle were provided to the Bayi Ordo.

s0480.idiomatic: Tong Prefecture and Chongming Prefecture of Yangzhou Route had strong winds and seawater overflowed.

s0481.idiomatic: First year of Zhihe, spring, first month, on yichou new moon, the king of Goryeo sent envoys to court to offer New Year's congratulations and present local products.

s0482.literal: On jiaxu day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0482.idiomatic: On jiaxu day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0483.literal: Orders were issued to paint the "Silo and Wheat Illustrations."
s0483.idiomatic: Orders were issued to paint the "Silo and Wheat Illustrations."

s0484.literal: On yihai day an edict addressed all offices: "All who do not proceed to their posts or who leave their duties without authorization shall be stripped of office;
s0484.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict addressed all offices: "All who do not proceed to their posts or who leave their duties without authorization shall be stripped of office;

s0485.literal: those who evade assignments shall be flogged.
s0485.idiomatic: those who evade assignments shall be flogged.

s0487.idiomatic: We request restoring the former system and appointing weighty ministers from the secretariat, censorate, privy council, and palace guard.

s0488.idiomatic: " On dingchou day the 14 articles of the Former Regulations on Agriculture and Sericulture were promulgated throughout the realm; officials were still ordered to encourage and inspect diligence and laxity.
